title: Focused recorded UIforETW diff
reference_disclaimer: These are replacement deterministic captures from commit d2ff0c119b1b8651c6326e482b984512403dbe0d using the real recorded google/UIforETW#74 Files-drawer selection path. The course selects the file first, then uses shipped reopenable actions to collapse Files, Conversations, and secondary review details. The retained 1280 x 1000 full-window viewport gives the native comparison 1262 x 890 pixels (98.5% of width and 89% of height). All runs use Qt 6.11.1 offscreen QFusionStyle at device pixel ratio 1. Judge only whether this focused full-window state makes the two exact replacement groups and their grounded gutter connectors reviewable. Native operating-system appearance integration, BPR-0220 geometry-rebuild attribution, BPR-0210 remediation, RFC closeout, and release readiness are outside this batch. The rejected v001 verdict is not carried forward.

subjects.display_name: Is the focused recorded diff legible enough for a real review?
subjects.description: The selected UIforETW.rc comparison contains two near-identical replacement pairs: 464,28 becomes 464,24 and 464,42 becomes 464,36. The earlier batch was rejected because non-diff chrome and the open Files drawer squeezed the code, clipped the changed coordinates, and made the gutter ribbon appear ungrounded. In this replacement, the drawers and large upper/detail regions are collapsed through shipped controls, both changed coordinate groups are selected in turn, and the final full-window state returns to the first group. Review the same exact blobs in Light, Dark, High-contrast Light, and High-contrast Dark.
acceptance_criteria: The full-window review state is code-first: the Files and Conversations drawers and large secondary review details are collapsed, and the two code panes plus gutter dominate the window
Both removed coordinate replacements have a narrow intraline-removed mark aligned with the changed digits and distinct from the whole-line removed band
Both added coordinate replacements have a narrow intraline-added mark aligned with the changed digits and distinct from the whole-line added band
The gutter connector visibly reaches both pane edges and overlaps the corresponding changed rows instead of appearing to point from nothing to nothing
The code-first allocation, exact marks, and grounded connectors remain reviewable in Light, Dark, High-contrast Light, and High-contrast Dark
known_concerns: The captures are offscreen QFusionStyle evidence, not a claim about native macOS, Windows, or Linux styling.
Compact navigation, review-layout, diff-status, and application-status controls remain visible so the collapsed surfaces can be reopened and the comparison can be navigated.

The deterministic course proves exact commits, blobs, both group selections, exact semantic-role pixels, connector geometry, focused-layout ratios, and a cut-wire negative. This decision is only the human visual judgement of the resulting pixels.

audit_verdict.note: The registered product contract passed four exact-profile captures and a fifth run with the real Qt selection wire cut. It independently validates the 1280 x 1000 full window, 1262 x 890 comparison, hidden drawer/detail state, both selected replacement groups, exact role-colour pixels, and pane-edge/row-overlapping connector geometry. Independent critical rereview returned CLEAR with no blocking or high-risk findings.
